snippet.title: The Wolf Among Us Remastered Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Step back into Fabletown in The Wolf Among Us Remastered - the definitive edition of Telltale’s acclaimed noir narrative thriller inspired by DC’s award-winning Fables comic series. 

Fully remastered with enhanced visuals and modern presentation, this definitive edition brings Bigby Wolf’s first investigation to life with greater atmosphere, immersion, and detail than ever before.

Available this Holiday 2026.

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10018232 
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/the-wolf-among-us-remastered/9NDP40GVGC80/0010 
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-wolf-among-us-remastered-73d444 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3884860/The_Wolf_Among_Us_Remastered/
